summary: Completed frontend testing of subscription pages with new weight-based pricing logic. All features working correctly: weight dropdown (100-5000gm options), price calculation (price/100 * selectedQty), dynamic delivery dates based on stock status.
critical_code_review_comments: SubscriptionCreate.js: getQtyOptions() correctly generates weight options 100-1000 (step 100) and 1500-5000 (step 500)
SubscriptionCreate.js: calculatePerDeliveryPrice() uses correct formula (product.price / 100) * qty
SubscriptionCreate.js: Delivery date calculation correctly handles in-stock (tomorrow) and growing (availability_date+1) products, skipping Sundays
Cart.js: Subscription section correctly displays weight (qty)gm and calculated price
SubscriptionDetail.js: Products section uses same weight-based pricing formula for display
context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscription pages updated with weight-based pricing. Key changes verified: 1) Weight dropdown with options 100-5000gm, 2) Price calculation: (price/100) * selectedQty, 3) Delivery dates: Tomorrow for in-stock, availability_date+1 for growing products (skip Sundays). All flows tested end-to-end.

SUBSCRIPTION_CREATE_STEP1_PRODUCT_SELECT.details: Products displayed with weight dropdown (Qty: 100-5000gm), dynamic delivery dates (Tomorrow for in-stock, Feb 7/Feb 17 for growing), price updates on weight change

SUBSCRIPTION_CREATE_STEP1_PRICE_CALCULAT.details: Price correctly calculated as (price/100) * selectedQty. Example: Turnip ₹180/100gm, 300gm = ₹540

SUBSCRIPTION_CREATE_STEP2_PLAN_SELECTION.details: Three plans displayed: Fresh Start (1/week), Balanced Nutrition (2/week, 10% OFF), Power Greens (4/week, 50% OFF). All show FREE DELIVERY badge

SUBSCRIPTION_CREATE_STEP3_ADD_TO_CART.details: Add to Cart button shows correct monthly total. Example: ₹540/delivery × 1/week × 4 weeks = ₹2160/month

CART_SUBSCRIPTION_DISPLAY.details: Cart shows subscription with: product name, weight (300gm), calculated price (₹540), start date, delivery days, monthly total (₹2160/mo)

DELIVERY_DATE_IN_STOCK.details: In-stock products show 'Delivery by Tomorrow' (or 'Delivery by Monday' if tomorrow is Sunday)

DELIVERY_DATE_GROWING.details: Growing products show 'Delivery by [date]' based on availability_date + 1 day. Example: Basil shows 'Delivery by Feb 7', Green Pea Shoot shows 'Delivery by Feb 17'

WEIGHT_DROPDOWN_OPTIONS.details: Weight dropdown shows options: 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1000 (and 1500-5000 for products with higher max weight)

mocked_apis_note: No mocked APIs - all operations use real backend endpoints
